name: Bácsszentgyörgy (Hungary)
description: Two horizontal stripes of red over blue in the ratio 1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bácsszentgyörgy: a shield of red and blue with an open book between two swords and Saint George slaying the dragon.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
